observations.title: Near-silence tail tests have low discriminating power
observations.detail: 1e-20 impulse with feedback < 1 cannot exceed the 1e-12 assertion threshold even pre-patch; tests guard future silence-region bugs but do not validate the denormal fix specifically and cannot measure CPU.

observations.title: Input scrub runs after beginBypassProcess dry-buffer capture
observations.detail: In all pedals (Delay/Flanger/Neural/Chorus/Octave) the dry buffer is copied before sanitization, so NaN input can transit the dry leg during a bypass crossfade. Engine health monitor + auto-heal backstop. Established codebase pattern, not a FIX1 regression; fixing it would alter ProcessorBase ordering semantics (out of scope).
